commentary.text: 90+4' Javier Alberola is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+3' Axel Witsel (Girona) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner, but his effort goes narrowly wide of the right post. This should be a big warning for the defence.
90+2' The ball goes out of play. Girona are awarded a corner kick.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' A pass into the penalty area from Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) is intercepted by the defence.
87' Substitution. Santiago Colombatto makes his way off the pitch and Leander Dendoncker (Real Oviedo) comes on as his replacement.
86' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Girona.
84' Girona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
81' Alex Moreno (Girona) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
80' Javier Alberola shows a yellow card to Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) for his blatant foul.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fran Beltran leaves the pitch and Cristhian Stuani (Girona) comes on.
79' The attendance is 20085.
77' Excellent touch by Axel Witsel (Girona)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort.
74' 1 - 0 Goal! Thiago Fernandez passes the ball to the feet of Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 1:0.
74' Javier Alberola couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) and blew his whistle.
72' What a chance for Thomas Lemar (Girona) as he produced a stunning snap shot from the edge of the box! The goalkeeper was a bit lucky as the ball goes inches over the crossbar.
70' Here is a change. Nacho Vidal is going off and Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves gives the last tactical orders to Lucas Ahijado (Real Oviedo).
70' Here comes a substitution. Nicolas Fonseca (Real Oviedo) is brought on as a substitute for Kwasi Sibo.
70' Substitution. Ivan Martin leaves the pitch and is replaced by Axel Witsel (Girona).
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Hugo Rincon (Girona) will replace Arnau Martinez.
69' Michel decides to make a substitution. Bryan Gil will be replaced by Claudio Echeverri (Girona).
68' Oviedo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

68' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. The linesman makes the right call and Oviedo will have a corner.
64' Jorge Guillermo Almada Alves prepares a substitution. Alberto Reina is replaced by Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo).
64' It will be a substitution. Thiago Fernandez (Real Oviedo) is ready to enter the pitch as Haissem Hassan walks off.
63' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marc-Andre ter Stegen, who smothers the ball.
63' Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
62' Bryan Gil (Girona) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Aaron Escandell comes off his line to intercept.
59' Bryan Gil (Girona) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
59' What a big chance! Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball well wide of the left post.

57' Marc-Andre ter Stegen makes a brilliant save! Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the bottom right corner but is saved by the keeper!
55' Kwasi Sibo (Real Oviedo) brings his opponent down. Javier Alberola has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
54' Arnau Martinez (Girona) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Oviedo.
51' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box.
51' Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo) will take a corner kick.
51' Javi Lopez (Real Oviedo) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. Now Oviedo have a corner.
50' Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo) takes the corner kick, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen reads it well and stops the effort.
50' Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The referee points to the corner flag and Oviedo will take a corner.
49' Alex Moreno (Girona) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball miles wide of the right post. Nice run, but poor finish!
47' Girona are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
46' The whistle blows and Javier Alberola starts the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.

45' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Marc-Andre ter Stegen, who pulls off a stunning save!
43' GOAL! No, cancel that as it has immediately been disallowed as the ball went out of play. Ivan Martin (Girona) is disappointed his strike won’t count.
42' The total number of attempts is 0:1.
41' A pass by Bryan Gil (Girona) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
39' David Carmo (Real Oviedo) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Javier Alberola had an easy-decision to make.
38' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
37' Oviedo work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
37' Javier Alberola blows his whistle. Thomas Lemar (Girona) commits a foul after dangerous play.
34' Thomas Lemar (Girona) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

32' The flag is raised by the referee's assistant. Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) is repeatedly being caught offside. He's always hanging on the shoulder of the last man to try and get into a scoring position.
32' Girona players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
30' Alex Moreno (Girona) is flagged for offside.
28' Javi Lopez (Real Oviedo) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
27' David Costas (Real Oviedo) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
26' David Costas (Real Oviedo) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
23' Alex Moreno (Girona) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
22' Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
22' Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
20' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.

19' What an opportunity! Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) wastes a huge chance as he latches on to a perfect pass and produces a first-time blast from point blank range. It goes towards the bottom left corner, but Aaron Escandell reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
14' Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) commits a foul during an attacking move.
12' Javier Alberola has a clear sight and sees a foul from Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo).
11' Javier Alberola blows his whistle and it's Arnau Martinez (Girona) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
11' Alex Moreno (Girona) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
10' The game is interrupted as Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) is flagged offside.
7' Fran Beltran (Girona) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
6' Bryan Gil (Girona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
5' A cross from a corner kick by Girona is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
4' Bryan Gil (Girona) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Girona.
3' Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
3' Javier Alberola blows his whistle after Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
2' David Costas (Real Oviedo) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
1' Vitor Reis (Girona) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
